text: きみの　じまん　なにか　きかせてよー　シールを　わけて　やるからさー

structure.jp: きみの　じまん　なにか　きかせてよー
structure.en: come on, tell me some brag of yours

structure.jp: シールを　わけて　やるからさー
structure.en: because I'll share stickers with you

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb on its own is a casual 'please do', and よ makes it coaxing. きかせてよー = 'come on, tell me'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a phrase means 'because', here added afterwards as the reason to do what he asked. やるからさー = 'since I'll give you some, y'know'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb means doing something for someone, said from above in a slightly cocky way. わけて　やる = 'I'll share some with you'.
